reason: On a student budget 55 CZK for one can is a lot when I meal-prep to save money, and I can get yerba mate cans cheaper on Rohlík. 'Natural' alone isn't enough reason for me to pay extra.
objection: Every brand says natural now; I don't see what makes this worth more than the cheaper mate I already know.
would_change_my_mind: If it sat in the fridge at the café where I eat lunch at around 40 CZK, or with a lunch-combo deal, I'd try it.
